title: Release Readiness Continuation
request: Continue the existing release planning tool from the prior phase. Add blocker-aware release readiness without rewriting the planner: items may declare blockers and carry-over provenance, ready items must exclude work blocked by incomplete dependencies, and the release summary must surface ready, blocked, carried-over, and overall readiness status.
context: Phase 1 already delivered a small in-memory release planner with add, list, complete, and summary behavior. Preserve that API unless a narrow extension is required.
Follow-up customer notes mention many future ideas, but this phase is only about blocker-aware readiness and carry-over provenance.
Do not replace the store with a framework or persistence layer. Keep tests deterministic with the existing injectable now() clock.
The prior delivery notes are available in docs/phase-1-delivery.md; use them as orientation, not as a reason to reimplement Phase 1.
successCriteria: Existing release planner tests continue to pass.
Items accept optional blockedBy dependency IDs and optional carryOverFrom provenance.
listReadyItems returns incomplete items whose blockers are all completed or absent.
summarizeRelease reports readyCount, blockedCount, carriedOverCount, and status.
